teaser: Lorenzo Cococcia explores offensive physical geolocation, using network latency trilateration across distributed sensors to locate adversary C2 servers.

title: Designing RFID Implants: Flipping the Bird Opens Doors
teaser: Miana Ella Windall chronicles designing and implanting custom subdermal RFID credentials to interact seamlessly with proprietary workplace access control readers.

title: The Risks of Pointing Out the Emperor is Buck Naked
teaser: Renderman and Tom Dang share first-hand accounts of facing legal retaliation when reporting government vulnerabilities, urging reform in public disclosure policies.

title: Cracking Cicada 3301
teaser: Leaders of the CicadaSolvers community detail the 9-year collaborative effort to decrypt Cicada 3301's Liber Primus runic cryptogram.

title: CON-trolling the Weather: Hacking Radiosondes
teaser: Paz Hameiri develops a simulation framework to spoof and jam weather balloon radiosonde telemetry, threatening global climate models and rocket launches.

title: A Series of Unfortunate Events: War Stories in Bug Hunting
teaser: Ben Sadeghipour (NahamSec) and Corben Leo share war stories from high-impact bug bounty engagements across prisons, major tech firms, and online casinos.

title: A Different Uber Post-Mortem
teaser: Former Uber CSO Joe Sullivan provides an inside retrospective on the 2016 Uber data breach, executive liability, and the criminalization of incident response.

title: Tracking the World's Dumbest Cyber Mercenaries
teaser: EFF researcher Cooper Quintin recounts tracking Dark Caracal, a Lebanese state-backed cyber-mercenary group whose comical operational security blunders exposed their operations.

title: XR Village Fireside Chat
teaser: Human rights attorney Brittan Heller discusses biometric privacy, spatial computing ethics, and civil liberties in immersive environments.

title: The History of XR: From Fiction to Reality
teaser: Traces the evolution of extended reality from sci-fi concepts into practical spatial computing hardware and platforms.

title: Push All the Buttons: Digital Twinning with Idaho National Laboratory
teaser: Details how Idaho National Laboratory uses XR digital twins to model, simulate, and stress-test critical infrastructure control systems.

title: Augmented Reality and Implications on Mobile Security
teaser: Examines the security and privacy implications of augmented reality sensor frameworks and camera feeds on mobile operating systems.

title: Securing Critical Versions of Your Reality
teaser: Suzanne Borders, Keenan Skelly, and Bryson Bort discuss how extended reality and immersive spatial data tools are applied to protect critical infrastructure systems.
